purpose: Repaint the four redesigned card abilities; replace game illustrations while retaining names and live rules in UI.

cards.name: neutral-medic
cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production portrait card illustration for the original game Mistrealm, 2:3 vertical composition. Input image is the existing card artwork and is the visual identity/style reference. Repaint the scene to clearly communicate the updated ability while preserving the recognizable protagonist, clothing, faction palette, gothic medieval setting, cinematic realistic painted detail and material richness. Strong focal silhouette readable at small card size; all important action in the central 75% of the frame. Full-bleed illustration only, no card frame, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Opaque background. Subject: the same dark-haired female field medic in worn grey cloak and linen scarf, now kneeling beside a fallen ordinary infantry soldier and helping him rise back to life. Her bandaged hand rests on his chest; a restrained warm ivory-gold life glow restores his breath and gathers into the soldier's hand gripping her forearm. The soldier is visibly rising to one knee, grounded and human, not a zombie. A lantern and linen bandages support the scene, ruined gothic field hospital behind. Clear compassionate revival action, no gore, no ghost armies, no giant spell circle. Warm lantern light against cold grey dawn. Medium shot, both medic's face and revived soldier's face/hands visible.
